requirements.description: One private three-by-three card applies the documented match-three prize profile without exposing covered values.
requirements.notes: Issue #77 allocates the permanent rules and privacy requirement for issue #87.

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own private reload-safe cards, partial reveals, history, and canonical route restoration.
requirements.notes: Session context overrides caller player ids and covered values remain private.

requirements.description: Each card uses one ledger wager debit and at most one payout credit under stable retry identities.
requirements.notes: No game code mutates balances directly and conflicting retries fail closed.

requirements.description: Scratch Cards supplies complete English and Russian responsive, accessible, reduced-motion-safe play across required viewports.
requirements.notes: Evidence covers both locales and every governed viewport.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, and long-suite discovery include Scratch Cards with requirement, module, version, and visual traceability.
requirements.notes: Descriptor sort order 130 and the catalog-discovered long driver are canonical.

requirements.description: Scratch Cards publishes private card preparation, funded state, reveal progress, immutable action records, settlement state, and action-owned cleanup through provider-current callbacks that replace only game-owned fields. Competing processes preserve unrelated player-state siblings and fail closed before a stale reveal or cleanup can overwrite the winning action, while covered prizes, the frozen v1 envelope, match-three profile, and exactly-once ledger movements remain unchanged.
requirements.notes: The frozen v1 contract, private covered-value boundary, three-by-three prize profile, debit and payout transaction types, and action keys remain unchanged. Production multiworker activation stays blocked because wallet and game-state publication remain separate durable boundaries.
